On June 25, 2026, Strange signed a three-year, $48 million contract extension with $25 million guaranteed with the Jaguars, keeping him with the team through the 2029 season.

On September 5, 2020, McLaughlin was waived by the Colts during final roster cuts.

On March 11, 2024, McLaughlin signed a three-year, $12.3 million contract extension with the Buccaneers.
